sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently 1st with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in commanding position and will be heavy favourites against bottom-of-the-table Alsager, who have won just once all season and are on a run of five losses in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Stafford Town (2nd, 20 points) travel to Dawley Town in a mid-table clash, while 3rd-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall (5th, 18 points) in a key top-six encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) visit Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday, then Brereton Social make the reverse trip to Wednesfield on Wednesday evening—Brereton themselves face Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) first on Saturday. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir in a mid-table fixture, Barnton entertain Shawbury United (16th, winless in five games), and Crewe host Allscott Heath. Market Drayton Town (10th) welcome New Mills (8th) in a battle of struggling sides, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a contest between two of the division's lowest scorers.
